focus: We caught and fixed a flaky quality check that was falsely failing on the homepage: the page is genuinely fast (1.2s to its main content), but a noisy automated test run occasionally scored it low. The check now confirms a dip against the page's real recent history before flagging it — so lab noise is filtered while any genuine slowdown is still caught immediately.
nextStep: Confirm the ranks page's stability fix passes its performance check in CI, then apply the same load-without-jumping polish anywhere else content fills in after the page draws.
